title: Soya Pilaf with Russian Twist
description: A flavorful pilaf dish with a blend of Eastern European and Asian flavors.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the Soya Pilaf and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the Malt Vinegar, Russian Dill, and Soy Sauce. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until the pilaf is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional Russian Dill if desired.
